exposure: blood biomarkers (interleukin (IL)-6, IL-8, IL-10, vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP))
cohort: The study included a cohort of very low birth weight neonates, categorized as fetal growth restricted (FGR) (birth weight <10%) or non-FGR.
finding: Fetal growth restriction was associated with specific inflammatory biomarker profiles, and higher levels of IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, and GFAP were associated with both FGR and brain injury, suggesting interleukins contribute to both conditions and GFAP may identify brain injury in FGR infants.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight neonates; FGR defined as birth weight <10th percentile.
